title: Eagle v. Savannah River Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC found the complaint administratively out of order because it could not be put in order: it was filed more than 30 days after the later of the SJC's October 21, 2021 reset notice and Presbytery's October 20, 2020 ruling, making it untimely under BCO 43-3. The SJC dismissed the case on a 19-0-0 vote. The attached SJC response to CCB is a separate request that CCB deny an exception request; it is not a 2022-01 merits disposition.
first_summary: The SJC dismissed Eric Eagle and others' complaint against Savannah River Presbytery as administratively out of order and untimely under BCO 43-3. The complaint was first filed prematurely in December 2020; after the SJC reset the filing clock, it was filed more than 30 days after the later of the SJC's October 21, 2021 action and Presbytery's October 20, 2020 ruling. The merits were not reached. An attached SJC response to CCB denied an exception request concerning its record-reopening in Case 2020-12.
summary: The SJC dismissed Eric Eagle and others' complaint against Savannah River Presbytery as administratively out of order and untimely under BCO 43-3. The complaint was first filed prematurely in December 2020; after the SJC reset the filing clock to the later of its October 21, 2021 action or Presbytery's October 20, 2020 ruling, it was filed more than 30 days later. The merits were not reached. An attached SJC response to CCB separately defended its record-reopening in Case 2020-12 and asked CCB to deny an exception request as untimely, waived, and procedural.
